eras.title: Colonies
eras.blurb: Jamestown starves, Plymouth prays, and thirteen very different colonies take root on land that was never empty.

eras.title: The Revolution
eras.blurb: Farmers stand on a bridge in Concord and fire at the strongest empire on earth.

eras.title: A New Nation
eras.blurb: The war is won. Now comes the harder part: inventing a country out of paper, promises, and argument.

eras.title: Westward
eras.blurb: Wagons roll toward the sunset. Some people are chasing a dream. Others are being forced from their homes.

eras.title: A House Divided
eras.blurb: Brothers aim rifles at brothers, and four million enslaved people wait to see if freedom is real.

eras.title: Rebuilding & Frontier
eras.blurb: A broken country stitches itself back together while railroads race across the plains.

eras.title: Machines & Immigrants
eras.blurb: Twelve million people sail past a copper statue with a torch, into a country being rebuilt by electricity.

eras.title: Depression & War
eras.blurb: Dust swallows the farms, then the world catches fire, and ordinary Americans answer.

eras.title: Freedom's Unfinished Work
eras.blurb: A seamstress keeps her seat, a preacher describes a dream, and America is asked to keep its oldest promise.

eras.title: Modern America
eras.blurb: Rockets, computers, and new neighbors. The story speeds up, and now it includes you.

capstone.title: The Patriot Badge
capstone.blurb: The final mastery quiz, the premium certificate, and a kid who knows the whole story. The proud parts and the hard parts.
